How to read a result

CELL rows carry an exact Excel sheet and A1 reference; PDF rows carry a page and line number; CBS, MAT, FORM, FACT and TBL rows carry the source document and a short context. Every figure in this dashboard is a value read from the 51 source documents. Derived quantities (four-track cost, NPT deductions, DLS, structural delta) are computed only from sourced rates, quantities and hours and are labelled by their basis in the master audit workbook. No value is invented, interpolated or rounded away; pages without a text layer are retained page by page in the warehouse.
